news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 1 experienced director. 4 highly experienced directors. Non Executive Independent Director Gautam Mohite was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2017. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Insufficient board refreshment.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.03 loss per share (vs ₹0.001 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.03 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹0.001 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹211.0k (up 2.4% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹119.0k (loss widened ₹114.0k from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 27% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 115% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
